collisionRules: Only one animation event may be active at a time.
Every moving primitive is clipped to the animation plane inside the table stage.
Animation z-index must stay below seats, controls, private choices, hand cards, and results.
Animations never carry hidden card identity; only a publicly discarded pair may show its fruit art.
At widths up to 650px opponent seats collapse to compact chips and leave the market core collision-free.
